text: Program Description What you will learn in this program The aim of this program is to train high-level professionals who have deep knowledge of English language and literature, broad knowledge of humanities and social sciences, innovation and cooperation, and can engage in teaching, translation and research in relation to English language. Courses you'll take English-Speaking Societies and Culture, Intercultural Communication English Reading and Commentary Introduction to Linguistics Introduction to Translation, Liaison and Interpreting, Advanced Literacy Academic Thesis Writing
